div.head: II Ew 1.2
div.ab: Ðæt is ðonne, ðæt nan man oðrum ryhtes ne wyrne.
Þæt is ðonne, þæt nan man oðrum rihtes ne wyrne.
Hoc est tunc, ne quisquam rectum disfortiet alicui.
Ðæt is ðonne, ðæt nan man oðrum ryhtes ne wyrne.
Nämlich dann, dass niemand einem Anderen Rechtsgang weigere.
Namely then, that no one refuse another [his] legal process.
Now his concern is that no man shall withhold from another his rights.

ðon, later with a stroke above it (abbreviation for ne?) B
Dieser Satz hat mit dem Gefolgseide vorher nichts zu tun, weshalb Q neue Rubrik davor setzt. Er knüpft an die Worte 1: ‘früher geboten’ an
This sentence has nothing to do with the preceding oath of fealty, which is why Q puts a new rubric before it. It links up with the words ‘commanded earlier’ in 1
